# A fake Zotero library

The zotero source type is the only one that needs a desktop application
running. Installing Zotero and filling it with invented papers is not something
a test can do, so this stands in for it:

```
library.json        collections, items and attachments — one file, invented
storage/<KEY>/*.pdf the attachments, generated by scripts/make_testdata.py
```

`scripts/zotero_stub.py` serves `library.json` in the shape of the Zotero 7
local API, on Zotero's own port:

```bash
python3 scripts/zotero_stub.py                 # http://localhost:23119/api/users/0
python3 scripts/zotero_stub.py --port 0        # any free port, for tests
```

With it running, `zotero_ingest.py` and every `curl` in the ingest skill behave
as they would with a real library. Point them at the fixture storage:

```bash
ZOTERO_STORAGE=tests/fixtures/zotero/storage \
  python3 scripts/zotero_ingest.py --source-id kestrel-zotero \
  --collection "Kestrel Islands" --project ~/lernkarten-demo
```

## What the library is made of

Every item exists to make one thing happen:

| Item | Attachment | What it tests |
|---|---|---|
| Currents in the Ashwind Sea | text-layer PDF | the ordinary case — metadata and text |
| Tide tables (scanned) | scan, no text layer | has to be left `pending:` for the Read tool |
| Bird counts on Bellhorn | none | counted as "without a PDF", no file written |
| A note item | — | skipped before anything else |
| Ferry statistics | text-layer PDF | sits in the *other* collection — a filtered run must not touch it |
| Signal code (offprint) | text-layer PDF | a PDF filed without a parent item |
| A link, not a file | HTML link | an attachment that is not a PDF |

Both collections (`Kestrel Islands`, `Mainland`) exist so that
`--collection` has something to include and something to leave out.

The stub is read-only, binds to localhost and serves invented data — but it
does occupy port 23119, so stop it before starting Zotero for real.
